checks.name: Data writeback is not requested before its in-flight threshold
A completed body prefix schedules actual background writeback
Credited transfer progress does not wait for a held disk flush
Shutdown joins an already running writeback before its file handle can close
Threshold requests are bounded/coalesced and successful flush statistics remain accurate
Finished writeback cannot schedule another operation
The optional background failure is exercised by the worker
An optional early-flush exception is recorded without replacing the required final flush
Owned real-file fixture opens the data writeback handle
Background operation performs real FlushFileBuffers on the owned data file
Successful prefinish writeback preserves exact bytes and joins before releasing the handle
